name: lying pelvic floor relaxation and deep breathing
description: A gentle lying breathing drill that lets the pelvic floor and belly relax. It helps you learn calm, deep breathing.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.
